package.name: sim_worlds
package.description: Gazebo Harmonic worlds for the SUAS search demo: a small fast "runway" test world and the SUAS 2026 competition field (Skyway Range), each with one hiker (mannequin) and one open pop-up tent per search area, QGC WPL 110 survey missions in the exact shape the team's main_controller expects, ground-truth files for scoring, and the generators/tools that build and check them.
package.maintainer: SUAS team (CPP Aerial Vision Analysis System)
